attributes.name: slogan/branding graphic treatment
attributes.definition: How a standalone slogan or brand graphic is presented on the page.

values.definition: A smaller slogan image placed inside a white card with a shadow.
Slogan graphic is present but presented some other way.

attributes.name: imagery density
attributes.definition: How much imagery appears across the page and in its cards.

values.definition: Cards contain only text and imagery is minimal, such as a single banner.
Some images are used in a portion of cards or sections.
Most cards and sections carry images.
